public_contract: itm-rework-v0.3-draft unchanged; no new data admission
scope: Fixed-R sampling intervention on exposed development panel

common.execution: all modules eval, float32, no autograd/AMP/optimizer/dropout; same backend as historical R; same input, reference, cache and motion decoding

input_transforms.base: Existing independently accepted 30Hz->20Hz input, train-only normalization, caption index, coordinates and root reference unchanged.
input_transforms.physical_static: At model 20Hz: a=0, O[t]=original O[0]; same mask/timestamps; normalize with old accepted train-only stats.
input_transforms.tail_reversed: At model 20Hz after interpolation: raw a and O jointly indexed [0,T-1,T-2,...,1] on all slots, then normalize; preserve frame timestamps/masks and original O[0] reference. No velocity sign flip or rotation inverse. Deliberately nonphysical sensitivity input.
input_transforms.numeric_zero: All normalized input entries zero; presence remains true. R reference still uses ORIGINAL source O[0] and normalized raw a=0. Never interpret zero rotation as valid orientation.
input_transforms.condition_off: strict presence gate; original raw backbone bypass remains available unchanged.
input_transforms.R_cache: Build observed and reference embeddings once per case in eval; subtract before adapters, then cache. No new MDM branch forwards per diffusion step.

Q.batch: Exactly one same-length MDM batch of5 per group, in probe_groups.json order; branch examples count5, not1. No mixing groups, padding or sequential branch fallback.
Q.conditions: f00/f10 use exact null cached control and false IMU presence, zero encoder calls; f00 text embedding zero. For paired/static/reversed compute observed and original-frame0 reference embeddings in eval, subtract with shared R encoder; max2 encodings per condition. Precache then form batch5.
Q.x_t: Same GT normalization, original diffusion betas/timestep_map/scaled t and valid noise as old exact D. No padding noise consumed. Replicate one x_t five times, save/hash target/noise/x_t/mask.
Q.output: Per480 slot save float32 f prediction [263,1,T], target, x_t, frame_mask, branch/source/config/t/noise/checkpoint/input/reference identities and actual scaled t; group5 ordering persisted. Float64 count/finite_count/MSE/RMS/max. Raw inputs/reference can use checked shared hash references.
Q.composition: Per96 group and3 IMU conditions: conceptual float64 unit=f11, legacy_reduced=f11+1.5*(f10-f00), a,b, cross and b-energy. Q intentionally lacks f01: do not report actual float32 four-branch replay or add f01 calls. Static f11 vs f10 checked on same batch.
Q.decision: Finite Q effect never changes S1 parameters or selects a model; software/identity/nonfinite/budget discrepancy stops remaining queue.

S1.only_intervention: Guidance scalar wt:2.5->1; no reduced-expression fast path or altered null/bypass execution. New versioned entrypoint, old D/L/R semantics unchanged.
S1.sampling: 60 fixed full samples, K1,1000-step DDPM,float32,clip_denoised=false, timestep_map=0..999; old12 noise groups preserved. Strict IMU-only gates text off despite audit caption.
S1.reference: numeric_zero uses normalized zeros but reference retains original observed O[0]; static equals reference; tail-reversal AFTER 20Hz interpolation [0,T-1,...,1], not a physical donor.
S1.output: Same120-independent-evaluation compatible arrays and identities as oldR, with new case/arm/package/guidance and explicit comparison_case_id + old artifacts; no metadata relabeling of old results.

trace.attach: Observe the existing four-branch batch and its actual combined return once at unscaled integer step before posterior update/noise addition. Detached independent snapshots only; no mutation, RNG use, callback model call, alternate branch execution or cache invalidation.
trace.output: Pertrace float32 x_t,f00,f10,f01,f11,actual_combined_prediction and same-call returned-prediction hash; frame mask,slot/t/scaled_t,branch flags,checkpoint/package/guidance/input/random plan IDs. Retain dtype/shape/hash and all finite counts; missing trace is incomplete diagnostic output, never silently ignored.
trace.offline: Recompose both weights on these same S1 states and report text-increment RMS/max plus combined differences. Optional direct GT feature MSE must be labeled S1-state diagnostic; no GT alignment, new model call or old-trajectory claim.
trace.limits: Old2.5 trajectory branch values were not recorded. Counterfactual recombination here is local on S1 trajectory only, not a full counterfactual rollout or old-state comparison.

software_tolerances.purpose: Software arithmetic and identity only; no effectiveness cutoff

inputs.original_orientation0: from original observation; no GT calibration

trace_absent_branch_equalities.description: Absent text: f00=f10 and f01=f11; absent IMU, bypass or R-static: f00=f01 and f10=f11. Save bitwise/max/RMS.

software_tolerances.trace_return: Observer attaches no replacement tensor; trace enabled/disabled CPU fixtures bitwise identical outputs AND RNG AND cache/call counters. Save returned prediction and same-call combined tensor with identical hashes.

float32_combination.reference: Convert stored float32 branches to float64. Compare actual combined prediction to factorized float64 expression and reduced f11+(wt-1)*(f10-f00). No requirement that unit==f11 bitwise.
float32_combination.reporting: All max/RMS differences plus maximum absolute-error/bound; finite bounds required; frozen scale-dependent rounding bound, never widened from observations.

float64_MSE_identity.reference: a=float64(f11)-float64(target), b=1.5*(float64(f10)-float64(f00)); all reductions float64 over valid entries

comparisons: new text_only vs new backbone_bypass: val6
new R-static vs new text_only: all12
new IMU-only vs historical IMU-only: val6
full_sample.report: All24 checks, bitwise and max/RMS; same exact seeds/inputs, no coordinate fit. Exceedance is replay/software discrepancy, not quality; halt later slots and retain complete ledger.

software_tolerances.nonfinite: Any nonfinite saved/returned tensor or required reduction stops the queue; finite poor effects do not stop or adapt the candidate

CPU_acceptance: Real new loader/entrypoint binds exact R final200, eval/static_delta, initial provenance, backbone/stats/environment; reject wrong checkpoint even if schema-compatible.
Q batch5 branch order and gates including caption-present audit vs text-off; identical x_t/noise across all5; off branches skip encoder; no padding or hidden sixth f01.
Actual four-branch function at wt1 and2.5 checked on analytic CPU fixtures; reduced float64 algebra tests do not substitute for method implementation tests.
Trace on/off yields bitwise-identical fixture outputs, random stream and cache/counters including off/static/bypass; exactly four predeclared timesteps; never extra real verification forwards.
Replay frozen60 input/reference/time/caption/noise identities incl train-reversed Q input; same numeric_zero/static semantics.

Q480/S1_60/trace240 startup ledger, pre-forward counter reservation, total/stage caps, first failure retention (during probe, sampling or trace write), exact outputs/failed/not-run slots; no retry/fallback.
All24 sample identity checks same-device tolerance frozen above; report checks only when counterparts completed, otherwise not_comparable, no fabricated pass.
execution: 01 implements/CPU validates;02 accepts concrete software;01 then obtains new authorization bound to final implementation+this package+unique run directory+GPU UUID. No actual GPU preflight before authorization.
